name: Lee Min-jae
bio:
Lee Min-jae's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by late-night broadcasts of Formula 1 races. While his dreams of racing were never realized, his analytical mind and knack for problem-solving led him down a different path. He started volunteering at local karting events, quickly becoming an indispensable resource for teams struggling with setup and data analysis. This experience landed him a junior role at Hot Car Competições, where he impressed senior staff with his dedication and ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights.

Now the test driver coordinator, Min-jae approaches his role with meticulous precision. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, often proposing unconventional testing strategies that have yielded significant performance gains. Though relatively new to the team, his commitment to excellence and his knack for spotting subtle nuances in driver feedback make him a valuable asset. His ability to connect the dots between technical data and driver experience is what makes him stand out.

physical.description: A young man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
